All JavaScript in one <script> tag at end of <body>, plain ES2019-compatible code, thoroughly commented with section banner comments. Must work by double-clicking from file://.

PAGE: <!DOCTYPE html>, <title>Gouraud-Shaded Cube — Canvas 2D</title>. Dark page background (#0a0c10), canvas centered via flexbox, canvas has width=800 height=600 attributes and CSS max-width:96vw; max-height:88vh keeping aspect ratio. Small caption under canvas: "Software Gouraud shading · Canvas 2D · W = wireframe · P = pause".

JS SECTIONS:

1) CONFIG: W=800, H=600, CX=W/2, CY=H/2, CAM_DIST=4.2 (camera at origin looking down +z; geometry translated +CAM_DIST in z), FOCAL=H*0.95 perspective scale, AMBIENT=0.18, DIFFUSE=0.95.

2) GEOMETRY:
- verts: 8 corners (±1.15, ±1.15, ±1.15) in this exact order: 0:(-,-,-) 1:(+,-,-) 2:(+,+,-) 3:(-,+,-) 4:(-,-,+) 5:(+,-,+) 6:(+,+,+) 7:(-,+,+).
- vnormals: per-vertex smooth normals = normalized vertex position (gives rounded Gouraud look).
- faces: 6 quads, indices CCW when viewed from OUTSIDE (outward normal = cross(v1-v0, v2-v1)), each with a base color:
  front  z+: [4,5,6,7] #ff5252
  back   z-: [1,0,3,2] #ffd54f
  right  x+: [5,1,2,6] #4fc3f7
  left   x-: [0,4,7,3] #69f0ae
  top    y+: [7,6,2,3] #b388ff
  bottom y-: [0,1,5,4] #ff8a65
- tris: split each quad (a,b,c,d) into triangles (a,b,c) and (a,c,d), storing {i0,i1,i2, color:{r,g,b}}. 12 triangles total.

3) MATH HELPERS: rotX(a), rotY(a), rotZ(a) returning 3x3 arrays; mat3Mul(A,B); mat3Vec(M,v); helpers sub(a,b), dot(a,b), cross(a,b), normalize(v); clamp255(x).

4) PER-FRAME PIPELINE in render(dt):
- Animation state: angX, angY, angZ and light time lt, advanced ONLY when not paused: angX+=dt*0.7; angY+=dt*0.9; angZ+=dt*0.35; lt+=dt.
- Moving light (world space, cube centered at world origin; camera sits at world z=-CAM_DIST): lightPos = { x: 3.2*cos(lt*0.9), y: 2.4*sin(lt*1.27), z: -2.5 + 2.0*sin(lt*0.53) } so it orbits mostly on the camera side, sometimes swinging wide for dramatic dark sides.
- R = mat3Mul(rotY(angY), mat3Mul(rotX(angX), rotZ(angZ))).
- For each of 8 vertices: world = mat3Vec(R, v); view = {x:world.x, y:world.y, z:world.z+CAM_DIST}; nrm = mat3Vec(R, vnormal).
- Per-vertex Lambert lighting (Gouraud): L = normalize(lightPos - world); diff = max(0, dot(nrm, L)); intensity[i] = AMBIENT + DIFFUSE*diff.
- Perspective projection per vertex: sx = CX + (view.x/view.z)*FOCAL; sy = CY - (view.y/view.z)*FOCAL (y-flip). Store in arrays px[], py[].
- For each triangle: view-space normal n = cross(Bview-Aview, Cview-Aview); BACKFACE CULL: skip triangle if n.z >= 0 (with outward-CCW winding and camera looking +z, visible faces have n.z < 0). Comment that for a convex cube with culling, visible triangles never overlap, so no z-buffer is needed.
- Vertex colors: for triangle vertex k using cube-vertex index i: r = clamp255(faceColor.r * intensity[i]) etc.
- Rasterize the filled triangle into the pixel buffer (section 5).

5) SOFTWARE RASTERIZER (true Gouraud: per-pixel color interpolation):
- Reuse one ImageData: img = ctx.createImageData(W,H) created once; buf32 = new Uint32Array(img.data.buffer).
- Clear each frame: buf32.fill(BG) where BG packs opaque background #0d1017. Packing helper pack(r,g,b) = (255<<24)|(b<<16)|(g<<8)|r with channels clamped 0..255 and rounded (little-endian ABGR).
- fillTriangle(p0,p1,p2) where each p = {x,y,r,g,b}: sort copies by y ascending (y0<=y1<=y2); return if y2-y0 < 1e-6 (degenerate). Standard scanline: for each integer y from max(0,ceil(y0)) to min(H-1,floor(y2)): interpolate along the long edge p0->p2 with t=(y-y0)/(y2-y0) giving (xLong, rLong, gLong, bLong); interpolate along the active short edge (p0->p1 if y<y1 using t=(y-y0)/(y1-y0), else p1->p2 using t=(y-y1)/(y2-y1); guard zero-length edges) giving (xShort, rShort, gShort, bShort). Let (xL,cL) and (xR,cR) be the two endpoints ordered by x. For integer x from max(0,ceil(xL)) to min(W-1,floor(xR)): s = (xR-xL) < 1e-6 ? 0 : (x-xL)/(xR-xL); r = rL + (rR-rL)*s etc.; write buf32[y*W+x] = pack(r,g,b).
- After all triangles: ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0).

6) WIREFRAME TOGGLE (key 'w'/'W', keydown listener): boolean wireframe. When true: still clear buffer and putImageData (dark background), skip triangle filling, then for each NON-culled triangle stroke its 3 edges with ctx (beginPath/moveTo/lineTo/closePath/stroke), strokeStyle = the face color lightened (e.g. mix 60% face color + 40% white), lineWidth 1.5. When false: solid Gouraud fill.

7) PAUSE TOGGLE (key 'p'/'P'): boolean paused; when paused, angles and lt do not advance, but rendering continues every frame so FPS and toggles stay responsive.

8) LIGHT INDICATOR: project lightPos (view z = lightPos.z + CAM_DIST) and if view z > 0.3 draw a small glowing marker at its projected position: two concentric circles (outer radius 9 rgba(255,240,180,0.25), inner radius 3.5 #fff6c8) drawn after putImageData.

9) FPS + HUD: fps EMA: fps = fps*0.92 + (1/dt)*0.08 guarded for dt>0. After putImageData draw HUD with fillText (font '14px ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace'): top-left inside a semi-transparent black rounded rect: 'FPS: ' + Math.round(fps); second line: mode 'SOLID' or 'WIREFRAME' (color #9fe8a9); if paused draw centered top 'PAUSED' badge in #ffd54f; bottom-left hint 'W wireframe   P pause' in #8fa3bf.

10) MAIN LOOP: requestAnimationFrame(loop); dt = (now - last)/1000 clamped to max 0.1 s; call render(dt) then HUD.

Code style: clear banner comments per section ('// ================= 3D pipeline =================' etc.), no external requests anywhere, no images, no fonts loaded. Ensure all parentheses/braces balanced and the script is syntactically valid ES2019."}
